uncited: It builds on [Visibility-Based Photometric Loss](2917-visibility-based-photometric-loss.md) by introducing an explicit visibility mask rather than relying solely on geometric consistency or fixed thresholds.
- **Trivial Solution:** Without $L_{vm}$, $V_M$ may converge to all zeros to minimize the photometric loss, effectively ignoring the entire image.
- **Segmentation Accuracy:** The effectiveness relies on the U-Net's or segmentation model's ability to accurately segment transient objects.
- **Depth Map Gaps:** Transient objects can cause gaps or inconsistencies in depth maps.
- **Time Complexity:** Adds the inference time of the U-Net or segmentation model for generating $V_M$ per training step.
- **Memory Complexity:** Requires storing the visibility map $V_M$ of size $H \times W$ per image.
